verdict.rationale: Penpot publishes an official, agent-agnostic MCP server that can be self-hosted, documented at penpot.dev/ai/mcp-server, and a runtime probe confirms it actually completes a real JSON-RPC initialize handshake exposing tools (e.g. high_level_overview) to any connecting agent. This is a genuine server-mode capability (not just client-side plugin integration), corroborated by both vendor docs and hands-on probe evidence. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) review of the MCP server's real-world reliability/tool coverage beyond the probe test.
